Mixed purées

Apple and peach semolina with yogurt

Almás-barackos búzadara joghurttal

6 months+ Adjusted 20 min 2 portions

Serve warm, with chicken or lentils so the bowl is not only semolina. This contains milk and gluten.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 25 g fine wheat semolina (gluten)
  • 200 ml water (for cooking the semolina)
  • 80 g plain pasteurised full-fat yogurt (milk allergen)
  • 60 g cooked apple (peeled, cored, and cooked)
  • 60 g cooked peach (peeled, pitted, and cooked)
  • a pinch Ceylon cinnamon (optional)
  • 50 g cooked chicken or cooked lentils (alongside; lentils boiled until completely soft)

Allergens

milkgluten

Method

  1. Stir the semolina into boiling water and cook, stirring, until soft and thick.
  2. Cook peeled apple and pitted peeled peach until soft, and blend them smooth.
  3. Cool the semolina until warm, then stir in the yogurt, fruit, and a pinch of Ceylon cinnamon if you want it.
  4. Do not add biscuit crumbs or sugar.
  5. Serve with shredded chicken cooked through, or with lentils boiled until completely soft.

Adjusted

Semolina is low in iron, so it should not be the whole meal. Biscuit crumbs add little of use and more gluten.

Cook the semolina in water, then stir in plain full-fat yogurt and cooked apple and peach, with a pinch of Ceylon cinnamon if you want it. Add shredded chicken or well-cooked lentils alongside, and leave biscuit crumbs out.
